trello.name: Send final renewal terms request to DataBridge
trello.desc: Send one final email today to DataBridge account manager in plain language requesting revised renewal terms by Thursday close of business. Contract lapses August 29th. Prior emails sent twice, last Monday with no response. Do not wait for Ravi; condition triggers next step if not replied by Thursday COB.

trello.name: Escalate DataBridge non-response to Legal
trello.desc: If DataBridge has not replied by Thursday close of business, escalate the renewal issue to legal on Friday morning to review termination-for-convenience options. Trigger is automatic on non-response by Thursday COB.

trello.name: Request security audit cryptography review from Dana
trello.desc: Message Dana from platform team today with the 60-page external security audit report. Ask her to review sections 4 and 6 covering cryptography and key management findings and send her assessment to the group before the next sync in two weeks. Frame request as from Ravi. If she lacks bandwidth, ask nicely first then escalate to her manager.
